Hi Elena / Marcus —

Thanks again for the call this morning. High-level recap and a proposed lightweight POC runway so we can validate the two core outcomes you mentioned: (1) reliably extract structured invoice data from customer PDFs with <85ms median gen latency for single-file flows, and (2) keep false-positive rate on vendor matching under 5%.

Proposed 4-week POC (attached PDF):
- Week 0 (this week): access provisioning, test data drop, confirm success criteria & acceptance matrix (owner: Novus).
- Week 1: baseline runs against 50 representative invoices, initial model / prompt tuning (owner: Redwood eng).
- Week 2: scale test to 500 invoices, edge-case handling, KV caching validation (owner: Redwood eng + Novus ops).
- Week 3: acceptance run, readout, and handoff doc (owner: joint).

Immediate asks from Novus:
1) Drop anonymized sample set (min 250 invoices) into the shared Drive by Tues 4/13.
2) Confirm a technical contact for VPC / firewall coordination (name + SSH / IP window).
3) Approve the acceptance matrix in the attached spreadsheet — we can adjust thresholds but prefer alignment up-front.

I've attached a draft POC runway and an acceptance matrix. Marissa will coordinate scheduling; Ben will own model configuration and benchmarking.

If this looks good I’ll lock the schedule and send calendar invites for the kickoff.

Best,
